rule: |price_after - price_before| >= $0.10 on consecutive recorded observations for the same market. Direction is the sign of the move.
high_roi_rule: roi_score >= 55 where roi_score = 45*min(|move|/0.25,1) + 25*min(liq/2000,1) + 15*(1-min(spread/0.10,1)) + 10*min(log10(1+volume)/4,1) + 5*(<=60min to close). A ranking aid, not a forecast.
